guitar.notes: Elliot Easton is known for using a Gibson ES-295/Travis Bean and other vintage guitars; reasonably documented new-wave guitarist.

tone.target: bright chorus-tinged pop rock with jangly clean bite
tone.profile: bright chorus-tinged pop rock with jangly clean bite
tone.summary: A classic pop-rock chain utilizing a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe) combined with Chorus for the signature jangly sound, supported by mild compression and room ambience.
corrections: keep chorus as the key texture

rig.name: The Cars - You Might Think - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Add sustain and even out the dynamics for jangly arpeggios.
Provide a subtle, clean bite and slight grit without heavy crunch.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its mild character, mimicking the low-gain drive clue. A dedicated Tube Screamer model would be ideal but is not available.

blocks.purpose: Create the signature bright, jangly chorus texture.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender-style tone required for pop rock.
Provide a bright and articulate cabinet sound matching the clean tone.
Enhance the bright top end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
Add subtle space and depth without sounding overly wet or deep.
Optional subtle echo for added dimension (kept inactive by default).

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better articulation of jangly arpeggios.

proposals.reason: Enhance clarity and bite for bright pop-rock tone.
